en.p: As shown in the figure, let $l$ be the line tangent at the point $\mathrm{P}(2,\,3)$ to the ellipse $\dfrac{x^2}{16}+\dfrac{y^2}{12}=1$ with foci at the two points $\mathrm{F}(c,\,0)$, $\mathrm{F'}(-c,\,0)\ (c>0)$. Let Q be the point in the second quadrant among the points where the line through F parallel to $l$ meets the ellipse. When R is the point where the two lines F'Q and $l$ meet, and S is the point where $l$ meets the $x$-axis, what is the perimeter of triangle SRF'? [4 points]
